samples.evidence: [/page/0/Text/7] Patients: Sixty-three adolescents referred for a mental health intake visit who met eligibility criteria. [page/2/Text/12] Analyses were conducted for the intent-to-treat sample (n=63). [003_participants] The sample consisted of adolescents aged 12 to 18 years who were referred to mental health clinicians in 1 of 5 schoolbased health clinics (3 middle schools and 2 high schools).
